C0025.title: Chengdu Police Crack Down on "Online Scalpers" Illegally Hoarding Hospital Appointments
C0025.summary: Chengdu police uncovered two cases involving the use of unauthorized software to maliciously seize appointment slots at well-known hospitals. A total of 54 suspects were arrested, five specialized "plug-in" programs were seized, and the total amount involved was found to exceed 13 million yuan.
